items.t: Samsung Smart Fridges Stop Cooling After Firmware Update in China
items.s: A routine firmware update left some Samsung smart refrigerators in China unable to cool, spoiling food and sparking complaints. The incident raises fresh questions about how much control connected appliances should have over basic household jobs.
Apple's audio brand Beats unveils its first new over-ear headphones in three years, the Beats 360, combining premium sound with innovative design to mark two decades of audio innovation.
